answers.core:
This feature *can* be implemented as an add-on, as demonstrated by [godot-overscan-demo](https://github.com/Calinou/godot-overscan-demo). However, an optimal implementation will require integration into core, specifically to automatically make use of VRS as mentioned above.

[^1]: Overscanned images currently appear less sharp. This is likely an issue with my implementation which could be fixed.
answers.workaround: This enhancement is likely to be used often in high-end 3D games, at least as an option for people with GPU power to spare. Overscan can also be useful for [offline rendering](https://github.com/Calinou/godot-photo-mode-demo), especially when coupled with supersampling to further improve image stability in motion.

title: Implement overscan to improve screen-space effect stability in motion
